This Belton TX home has the layout big families and PCS households actually need. Three bedrooms on the main floor — including the primary — so you've got options for a nursery, guest room, or home office downstairs. Upstairs adds two more bedrooms PLUS a second living room, perfect for a playroom, teen hangout, or movie space.

✔️ 5 bedrooms total
✔️ 3 full bathrooms
✔️ 2,998 sqft
✔️ Belton ISD — one of the most sought-after school districts in Central Texas
✔️ Easy commute to Fort Cavazos (Fort Hood)

Moving to the Killeen / Belton / Temple area or PCSing in? I've helped military families and local buyers since 2018, and I know VA loans and sight-unseen moves inside and out. Veteran spouse, here to make your move easy. 💙
